item.title: Tuesday 10 AM Update, Nov 17
item.description:
The Tuesday 10 a.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 17, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow; Navy secretary nominee Hung Cao's confirmation hearing and DHS saying the recent outages were not an attack; Iranian drones at a US radar site in Bahrain and a second strike on the Crimean bridge; Turkey seizes the opposition channel Sozcu TV; stocks mixed at the open after a soft retail sales report, Intel slides as Nvidia trims its stake, and the Deutsche Bank files leak; Nvidia's new national security committee; Isomorphic Labs raises five billion dollars and Google retires Gemini Gems; the Fugaku supercomputer breach and attacks on Check Point gateways; your X feed; the Saint-Gobain PFAS meeting and the Associated Grocers strike; and the teachers who built a bus stop for a student. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Tuesday Morning, Nov 17
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Monday 1 PM Update, Nov 16
item.description:
The Monday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 16, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow; the Supreme Court turns away cases on university research grants and Maryland's gun-free zones; three people shot in the Bronx's Co-op City; Britain's prime minister says Brexit hasn't worked; new Iranian claims in the Strait of Hormuz; stocks slide at midday as a source says Nvidia's board isn't considering Jensen Huang's return; new US limits on remote access to AI chips and a study on data center power use; OpenAI lets outside safety testers inside; Anthropic shortens its bug disclosure deadline and AI-run hacking from a China-linked group; your X feed; Drake Maye's injury and Londonderry's budget; and a marathon moment of sportsmanship. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
